description: Combine tuple genomes and mutate a bounded set of numeric candidates.
generation_prompt: Use tuple-based crossover and a bounded generation loop for numeric optimization.
style_note: tuple crossover and explicit generation counter
ground_truth_reason: Ground truth is based on candidate flow and operations, not names. Positive evidence: population: a collection of candidate genomes is initialized and carried through the optimizer; fitness: a computation derives a score or loss from each candidate; selection: candidate-derived parents are chosen by ranking or top-k filtering; mutation: a candidate copy is changed to produce a new candidate; crossover: a child combines data from two distinct candidate-derived parents; replacement: the active candidate collection is rebuilt or updated with selected parents and offspring; termination: a generation, score, or convergence condition governs the evolutionary process. Negative evidence: all seven role behaviors are represented. Prompt intent: Use tuple-based crossover and a bounded generation loop for numeric optimization. Policy basis: The process is generation-bounded, operates on in-memory candidates, and contains no capability or hard resource violation.
